title: Shoot the locks
description: Adds compatibility with locks unofficial (and Locks Reforged) and Scorched Guns 2. Now you can shoot locks to open them.
body:
This small mod provides compatibility between the Locks Unofficial mod and Scorched Guns 2. Now, when you shoot at a closed lock, there is a chance that it will be unlocked. You will not be able to open locks that are enchanted with certain enchantments in this way.

This mod requires SCORCHED GUNS 2 and Locks Unofficial (also works with Locks Reforged), as well as their dependencies.
